fields.label: Microsoft Graph Connected App
fields.description: Select the Connected App configured for Microsoft Graph API access.

fields.label: Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) Group ID
fields.description: Enter the Object ID of the Microsoft 365 Group whose SharePoint site you want to use.

fields.label: Fetch SharePoint Site/Drive IDs from Group ID
SharePoint Site ID
fields.description: The ID of the target SharePoint Site (obtainable via Graph API/Explorer).

fields.label: SharePoint Drive (Library) ID
fields.description: The ID of the target Document Library (Drive) within the SharePoint Site.

fields.label: Base Folder Path
fields.description: The base path within the Drive where documents will be stored (e.g., 'Shared Documents/Folder').
